LESSON_SIX_GRAMMAR_ONE.titleEnglish: Express a Learned Ability with 會
LESSON_SIX_GRAMMAR_ONE.learnerPromise: Say what someone knows—or does not know—how to do.
LESSON_SIX_GRAMMAR_ONE.explanation: 會 marks a skill you get through learning. Put it before the action: 我會游泳. Negate with 不會: 我不會打棒球.

teachingGlossary.meaning: shows belonging or links a describing word

discoveryLab.title: Flip the skill switch
discoveryLab.description: The activity stays the same. 會 tells whether the skill is available.

choices.label: Skill off
choices.english: I do not know how to play baseball.
choices.note: 不 goes directly before 會.

choices.label: Ask about a skill
choices.english: Do you know how to cook?
choices.note: 會不會 asks whether the skill is available.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Person + 會 + skill. Use 不會 for no skill and 會不會 to ask.

items.question: I know how to cook. Is it 我做飯會?
items.answer: No — 會 goes before the action word: 會做飯.

items.question: To say I cannot swim, is it 我會不游泳?
items.answer: Put 不 directly before 會: 不會游泳.

text.traditional: A：你會不會做飯？ B：我會做飯。
text.simplified: A：你会不会做饭？ B：我会做饭。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ huì bú huì zuòfàn? B: Wǒ huì zuòfàn.
text.english: A: Do you know how to cook? B: Yes, I do.

text.traditional: A：今天下午我們去游泳，好不好？ B：我不會游泳，我們去打球吧。
text.simplified: A：今天下午我们去游泳，好不好？ B：我不会游泳，我们去打球吧。
text.pinyin: A: Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒmen qù yóuyǒng, hǎo bù hǎo? B: Wǒ bú huì yóuyǒng, wǒmen qù dǎ qiú ba.
text.english: A: How about we go swimming this afternoon? B: I cannot swim. Let’s play ball.

text.traditional: A：你會做甜點嗎？ B：會，我會做很多種甜點。
text.simplified: A：你会做甜点吗？ B：会，我会做很多种甜点。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ huì zuò tiándiǎn ma? B: Huì, wǒ huì zuò hěn duō zhǒng tiándiǎn.
text.english: A: Can you make desserts? B: Yes. I can make many kinds.

LESSON_SIX_GRAMMAR_TWO.titleEnglish: Describe How Well You Do an Action with 得
LESSON_SIX_GRAMMAR_TWO.learnerPromise: Describe how well, fast, slowly, much, or happily an action is done.
LESSON_SIX_GRAMMAR_TWO.explanation: Use 得 after a verb to describe how well you do it: 跑得很快. If there is an object, repeat the verb (跑步跑得很快) or say the object first (網球打得很好).

teachingGlossary.meaning: shows how an action is done
shows belonging or links a describing word

discoveryLab.title: Choose the lane to 得
discoveryLab.description: Every lane ends with verb + 得 + performance. The activity’s shape decides what comes before it.

choices.label: Simple verb
choices.note: The action word 跑 goes straight before 得.

choices.label: Repeat the verb
choices.pinyin: Wǒ pǎobù pǎo de hěn kuài.
choices.note: Say the full activity 跑步, then repeat the action word 跑 before 得.

choices.label: Move object forward
choices.note: 網球 becomes the topic, leaving 打 next to 得.

choices.label: Owned activity
choices.traditional: 他的牛肉麵做得很不錯。
choices.simplified: 他的牛肉面做得很不错。
choices.pinyin: Tā de niúròumiàn zuò de hěn búcuò.
choices.note: 他的牛肉麵 is the topic; 做 still stands directly before 得.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Protect the core: action word + 得 + performance. Move or repeat the thing when needed.

sentenceSpine.title: Build the unbreakable core
sentenceSpine.description: Three blocks. The middle block is the rule that never changes.
notes: Right: 跑步 + 跑得 + 很快. Repeat 跑 so the action word touches 得.
Wrong: 跑步 + 得 + 很快. The word 步 cannot attach directly to 得.

items.question: When I say he runs fast, is the middle word 的 or 得?
items.answer: 得. 得 links the action word to how it is done; 的 shows belonging.

words.meaning: shows how an action is done

items.question: He plays tennis very well. Can I say 他打網球得很好?
items.answer: Put 網球 before 打, or repeat 打, so the verb comes directly before 得.

words.meaning: shows how an action is done

items.question: I run very slowly. Is it 我跑很慢得?
items.answer: Put 得 directly after 跑 and before 很慢.

words.meaning: shows how an action is done

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe how well, fast, slowly, much, or happily an action is done.
grammarPages.explanation: Use 得 after a verb to describe how well you do it: 跑得很快. If there is an object, repeat the verb (跑步跑得很快) or say the object first (網球打得很好).

discoveryLab.title: Choose the lane to 得
discoveryLab.description: Every lane ends with verb + 得 + performance. The activity’s shape decides what comes before it.

choices.label: Simple verb
choices.note: The action word 跑 goes straight before 得.

choices.label: Repeat the verb
choices.pinyin: Wǒ pǎobù pǎo de hěn kuài.
choices.note: Say the full activity 跑步, then repeat the action word 跑 before 得.

choices.label: Move object forward
choices.note: 網球 becomes the topic, leaving 打 next to 得.

choices.label: Owned activity
choices.traditional: 他的牛肉麵做得很不錯。
choices.simplified: 他的牛肉面做得很不错。
choices.pinyin: Tā de niúròumiàn zuò de hěn búcuò.
choices.note: 他的牛肉麵 is the topic; 做 still stands directly before 得.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Protect the core: action word + 得 + performance. Move or repeat the thing when needed.

sentenceSpine.title: Build the unbreakable core
sentenceSpine.description: Three blocks. The middle block is the rule that never changes.
notes: Right: 跑步 + 跑得 + 很快. Repeat 跑 so the action word touches 得.
Wrong: 跑步 + 得 + 很快. The word 步 cannot attach directly to 得.

items.question: When I say he runs fast, is the middle word 的 or 得?
items.answer: 得. 得 links the action word to how it is done; 的 shows belonging.
